title: CycleDebt Certificate
description: Machine-checkable obstruction certificate produced by scripts/cyclediagnostic_demo.py. All rational-number fields use SymPy canonical string form: an integer 'n' or a fraction 'n/d' where d > 0.

system_name.description: Human-readable name of the diagnostic system

arithmetic.description: Arithmetic domain used (must be exact rational)

is_cocycle.description: True iff delta^1 r = 0 (local coherence holds)

is_admissible.description: True iff delta^0 b = r is solvable (globally admissible)

dim_H1.description: Dimension of H^1(G; Q): number of independent cyclic obstructions

residue.description: Interface residue r in C^1(G; Q), one entry per edge in order

edges.description: Edge labels in the same order as residue entries

L1_matrix.description: Hodge Laplacian L1 = D0 D0^T + D1^T D1, stored for independent verification

D1_matrix.description: Coboundary map D1: C^1 -> C^2. Empty array when there are no faces.

harmonic_basis_vectors.description: Basis for ker(L1): each row is one harmonic 1-cochain representing H^1

G.description: Gram matrix G[i][j] = <h_i, h_j> of the harmonic basis

p_periods.description: Obstruction periods p_i = <h_i, r>, one per harmonic basis vector

r_debt_vector.description: Harmonic projection r_debt = G^{-1}p * h (the irremovable debt component)

debt_norm_squared.description: Warrant debt magnitude D = ||r_debt||^2 = p^T G^{-1} p

gram_harmonic_agree.description: Cross-check: Gram formula and harmonic projection give equal D

oneOf.description: Refinement options that kill the obstruction (warrant_debt case only)

rational_string.description: Rational number in SymPy canonical form: integer 'n' or fraction 'n/d' (d > 0)

rational_matrix.description: Matrix of rational numbers stored as arrays of arrays of rational_string
